read: The board leans risk-off but bouncing: BTC has a 1d breakdown on volRatio 2.2 while most alts rallied off swept lows. The largest local imbalance is XMR funding 166.24, 110.08 over CEX.

brief: Delta: the board bounced hard off the weekend lows (NEAR +7.21, ENA +9.93, LINK +9.06, AAVE +9.78 over 24h) while BTC stays under its broken 1d range low (volRatio 2.2) and Nasdaq fell on Friday. HL funding is neutral almost everywhere, so crowding is the exception: XMR 166.24, HYPE 85.59, XPL 72.16, ZRO 56.38. Two L2 cancels: XMR long (funding flipped to crowded) and kPEPE short (funding reset). New: BTC short on a retest of the broken 1d low20 and an XPL fade of HL-local crowding; both low conviction. We lean toward more chop than trend; BTC reclaiming the prior day high would prove the short wrong, and XPL funding resetting would break the fade (L2). Gap: hl-cycles is stale (2.7 h).
